summary_en: Dai Nippon Printing announces launch of tender offer for all ordinary shares of AUSTRIACARD HOLDINGS AG (Austria-listed; Vienna Stock Exchange and Euronext Athens). Offer price EUR 10.0/share (including dividend). Tender period 10 weeks (2026-06-12 to 2026-08-21, Vienna time). Settlement expected Q2 FY2027, subject to foreign-investment and competition-law regulatory clearance. Target business: payment IC cards, national ID solutions, variable security printing in Europe, Africa, North America.
title_en: Notice Regarding Launch of Tender Offer for Ordinary Shares of AUSTRIACARD HOLDINGS AG, Austria-Listed Company (Disclosure Item Progress)
translation_en_brief:
Dai Nippon Printing Co., Ltd. (DNP) announces the launch of a tender offer for all ordinary shares of AUSTRIACARD HOLDINGS AG, an Austria-listed company (trading on Vienna Stock Exchange and Euronext Athens). The company operates payment IC card, national ID solution, and variable security printing businesses across Europe, Africa, and North America.

The offer price is EUR 10.0 per ordinary share (dividend-inclusive). The tender period runs for 10 weeks from 2026-06-12 to 2026-08-21 (Vienna time). DNP intends to complete settlement of subscribed shares and consolidate AUSTRIACARD as a subsidiary in Q2 of fiscal year ending March 2027, contingent on receipt of regulatory clearance under applicable foreign-investment regulations and competition law. The timing of settlement may shift depending on when such regulatory clearances are obtained. The Offer Document, prepared in accordance with Austrian public takeover law, was published on 2026-06-12 and is available on the websites of DNP, AUSTRIACARD, and the Austrian Takeover Commission.
